{'下月 26 日是大埔宏福苑火災一周年': "Next month the 26th marks the one-year anniversary of the Tai Po Wang Fuk Court fire. The independent committee investigating the blaze is expected to submit its report to the Chief Executive before the end of October. Recent media reports indicated that the government has activated the Head of Department Accountability System to investigate the administrative responsibility for the fire, and has redeployed Administrative Officers to assist. Chief Executive John Lee today (the 6th) did not confirm whether the mechanism has been activated, only stating that the government has made a series of arrangements and will push forward reforms and accountability as soon as possible after the report is submitted. The luxury residence One Stanley in Stanley was exposed for using steel reinforcement that did not match the plans. Lee said the Buildings Department is investigating the case and he has requested the Development Bureau to oversee the investigation. With multiple projects successively revealed to have problems, he said he attaches great importance to the construction quality of building works in Hong Kong, which concerns the professional standard, quality and safety of Hong Kong's construction industry, and the government will strictly enforce the law."}

{'宏福苑火災近一年，獨立委員會預計 10 月底前會提交報告。（資料相片）': 'Nearly a year after the Wang Fuk Court fire, the independent committee is expected to submit its report before the end of October. (File photo)'}

{'早前有傳媒報道，兩位政務官保安局前副秘書長莫君虞、體育專員蔡健斌，會在公務員敘用委員會轄下調查小組做支援工作，專責為行政問責做前期工作。': 'Earlier media reports said that two Administrative Officers, former Deputy Secretary for Security Alex Mook and Commissioner for Sports Carlson Tsoi, would provide support to an investigation小组 under the Public Service Commission, dedicated to preparatory work for administrative accountability.'}

{'行政長官李家超今出席行政會議前見記者，被問及事件是否屬實？啟動部門首長責任制調查責任下，是否意味即使有報告，如涉及官員問責都不是馬上有結果，公眾要等幾耐？': 'Chief Executive John Lee met the press before attending the Executive Council meeting today. When asked whether the reports were true, and whether activating the Head of Department Accountability investigation means that even with a report, accountability involving officials would not yield immediate results and the public would have to wait a long time, he was questioned.'}

{'李家超指，他一早講明當獨立委員會提交報告後，會積極研究和跟進建議，進行改革並公布細節。他未有正面回應是否有政務官，已被調職往準備前期調查工作，僅稱「政府呢段期間已作了一系列部署」，強調報告提交後會根據內容，「在短期內盡快推行全面改革，並追究責任」，到時會作詳細公布。': 'Lee said he had made clear from the start that after the independent committee submits its report, he would actively study and follow up on its recommendations, carry out reforms and announce the details. He did not directly respond to whether Administrative Officers had been redeployed to prepare the preliminary investigation work, only saying that "the government has made a series of arrangements during this period," stressing that after the report is submitted, based on its content, he would "push forward comprehensive reforms and pursue accountability as soon as possible in the short term," and would make a detailed announcement at that time.'}

{'李家超指獨立委員會提交報告後，會盡快據報告內容推行改革、追究責任。（資料相片）': "Lee said that after the independent committee submits its report, he will push forward reforms and pursue accountability as soon as possible based on the report's content. (File photo)"}

{'李家超又重申多次表示改善措施急不容緩，故在 9 月發表施政報告時，已宣布 7 項優先改善措施，包括地盤禁煙、加強消防裝置規管、加強專業人士和承建商處分和懲治、提高業主大會合規運作、研究圍標刑事化、首次提供招標和評標服務、制訂顧問和承建商預審名單、以及研究方案更好協助市民工程涉及專業性。': "Lee reiterated several times that improvement measures are urgent. Therefore, when delivering the Policy Address in September, he announced seven priority improvement measures, including banning smoking at construction sites, strengthening regulation of fire service installations, strengthening disciplinary action and punishment against professionals and contractors, improving the compliant operation of owners' corporations, studying the criminalisation of bid-rigging, providing tendering and tender evaluation services for the first time, establishing a prequalification list for consultants and contractors, and studying solutions to better assist the public on professional aspects of building works."}

{'翻查資料，公務員敍用委員會是獨立法定諮詢機構，向行政長官就公務員聘任、晉升、紀律事宜提供意見。部門首長責任制由特首李家超在去年的施政報告提供，按部門問題嚴重性，訂立兩級調查機制。若問題性質較不嚴重、屬單一事件等，將由部門首長進行第一級調查。如部門出現嚴重問題，或涉及廣泛、重複性的系統問題，或可能涉及部門首長的角色時，會由「公務員敍用委員」領導的調查小組，展開第二級調查。': "According to records, the Public Service Commission is an independent statutory advisory body that advises the Chief Executive on matters relating to the appointment, promotion and discipline of civil servants. The Head of Department Accountability System was proposed by Chief Executive Lee in last year's Policy Address, establishing a two-tier investigation mechanism based on the severity of the departmental issue. If the problem is less serious in nature or is an isolated incident, the head of department will conduct a first-tier investigation. If the department has a serious problem, or involves a widespread or repetitive systemic issue, or may involve the role of the head of department, a second-tier investigation will be conducted by an investigation小组 led by the Public Service Commission."}

{'豪宅 One Stanley 被揭有單位鋼筋與圖則不符，李家超稱不評論仍在調查的個案，已要求發展局監察屋宇署調查。': "The luxury residence One Stanley was revealed to have units where the steel reinforcement did not match the plans. Lee said he would not comment on the case while it is under investigation, and has requested the Development Bureau to oversee the Buildings Department's investigation."}

{'One Stanley「抽筋」\u3000要求發展局監察調查': 'One Stanley "missing rebar" – Development Bureau requested to oversee investigation'}

{'近日接二連三有建築工程被揭發出現問題，包括瑪麗醫院新大樓𨋢槽傾斜、東涌公屋有石屎樣本強度不符標準、赤柱豪宅 One Stanley 樓板鋼筋不符圖則。李家超被問到是否在施工、以至工程監管出現問題？': 'Recently, problems with building works have been exposed one after another, including tilting lift shafts in the new block of Queen Mary Hospital, concrete samples from a Tung Chung public housing estate failing to meet strength standards, and floor slab steel reinforcement at the Stanley luxury residence One Stanley not matching the plans. Lee was asked whether problems have arisen in construction and project supervision.'}

{'他回應 One Stanley 工程問題，指屋宇署正嚴正調查個案，「查明施工質量和監工是否到位問題，會依法嚴厲處理」，而由於仍在調查中，不評論個案內容，已要求發展局監察案件調查。但他強調，重視香港建築工程的施工質素，「關注跟工程有關的專業人員有否盡職監督，承建商有否違規施工」，又指關乎香港建築的專業水平、質量和安全，政府必然嚴格執法。': 'Responding to the One Stanley project issue, he said the Buildings Department is rigorously investigating the case, "to ascertain whether construction quality and supervision were properly carried out, and will handle it strictly in accordance with the law." As the investigation is ongoing, he would not comment on the details of the case, and has requested the Development Bureau to monitor the investigation. However, he stressed that he attaches importance to the construction quality of building works in Hong Kong, "is concerned about whether professionals related to the works have diligently supervised, and whether contractors have carried out construction in violation of regulations," and pointed out that this concerns the professional standard, quality and safety of Hong Kong\'s construction industry, and the government will inevitably enforce the law strictly.'}

{'他亦已要求發展局針對整體建築工程，提升法律方面的規管要求和懲處，確保法例阻嚇力，嚴懲違規有關人員，保障香港建築工程專業水平、質量和安全。而發展局會在今年提交《建築物條例》修訂建議，強化監管和加強懲處制度和罰則，當局會全速推進有關工作。': "He has also requested the Development Bureau to enhance legal regulatory requirements and penalties for building works overall, to ensure the deterrent effect of legislation, strictly punish those who violate regulations, and safeguard the professional standard, quality and safety of Hong Kong's building works. The Development Bureau will submit proposed amendments to the Buildings Ordinance this year to strengthen regulation and the disciplinary and penalty regime, and the authorities will push ahead with the work at full speed."}

{'護士畢業生搵工難最近引起關注，李家超指護士需求長期存在，又指醫管局目前有 3000 多個護士職位空缺，畢業生可申請。（資料相片）': 'The recent concern over nursing graduates finding it difficult to secure jobs has drawn attention. Lee said demand for nurses has long existed, and noted that the Hospital Authority currently has more than 3,000 nursing vacancies, which graduates can apply for. (File photo)'}

{'行會張宇人批「工會扮人」\u3000李家超指需求長期存在': 'ExCo member Cheung Yu-ming criticises "unions impersonating callers" – Lee says demand has long existed'}

{'護士搵工難討論近期升溫，事源施政報告後電台節目 Phone-in，自稱在紀律部隊任精神科護士的郭先生稱，申請延期退休不獲批、而護理系畢業女兒畢業即失業，質疑醫管局引入內地醫護。行會成員張宇人其後質疑是工會「分分鐘扮人打電話」，表明舉腳贊成輸入外地人才。': 'The discussion over nurses\' difficulty in finding jobs has intensified recently. The issue arose from a radio phone-in programme after the Policy Address, in which a Mr Kwok, who claimed to be a psychiatric nurse in a disciplinary force, said his application for deferred retirement was not approved, and that his nursing graduate daughter was unemployed right after graduation, questioning the Hospital Authority\'s importation of Mainland medical staff. Executive Council member Tommy Cheung subsequently questioned whether it was unions "calling in and pretending to be someone," and expressed his full support for importing outside talent.'}

{'記者問到護士畢業生難搵工，如何解決空缺集中在資深護士？如何回應行會成員言論被指激化社會矛盾？李家超指，無論每一個行業，都存在畢業後因個別原因而不即時求職、又或招聘機構挑選最適合需要，「而出現個別人士不獲聘的情況」。他強調社會對護士需求一直存在，尤其香港醫療不斷發展、人口老化的趨勢，「所以招聘數字最終必然反映這些存在需求」。他又不點名指，「社會在呢方面有不同討論，令大家可更加將問題討論清楚」。': 'When reporters asked about nursing graduates\' difficulty in securing jobs, how to address the concentration of vacancies among experienced nurses, and how to respond to ExCo members\' remarks being accused of aggravating social divisions, Lee said that in every industry, there are cases where graduates do not immediately seek employment for various reasons, or where recruiting organisations select the most suitable candidates, "resulting in situations where certain individuals are not hired." He stressed that society\'s demand for nurses has always existed, particularly given Hong Kong\'s continuously developing healthcare and the trend of an ageing population, "so the recruitment figures will inevitably reflect this existing demand in the end." Without naming names, he also said, "there are different discussions in society on this aspect, which allow everyone to discuss the issue more clearly."'}

{'李家超亦指根據 2025/26 年數字，約有 4000 名潛在護士畢業生，實際應徵醫管局約有 2500 人，即有 1500 人是應徵醫管局以外職位，而醫管局現時仍有 3000 多個護士職位空缺，「護士畢業生係可以申請，係有機會獲聘」。': 'Lee also pointed out that according to 2025/26 figures, there are about 4,000 potential nursing graduates, with around 2,500 actually applying to the Hospital Authority, meaning 1,500 are applying for positions outside the HA. The HA currently still has more than 3,000 nursing vacancies, "nursing graduates can apply, and have the opportunity to be hired."'}

{'醫衞局局長盧寵茂早前接受多間媒體訪問，澄清政府招聘政策一定是本地人才優先。李家超亦重申根據醫管局現有護士數目，「99.8% 都係香港本地培訓護士」，明確落實本地人才優先聘用政策；又指目前有 40％ 護士在公營醫療體系任職、其餘 60％ 在其他醫療崗位，如社區護理、安老、復康服務、私營醫療機構等工作。他強調社會對護士需求長期存在，政府會按醫療服務需要，跟業界學界交流意見，就醫護培訓和人力發展做好規劃。': 'Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau earlier clarified in interviews with several media outlets that the government\'s recruitment policy definitely prioritises local talent. Lee also reiterated that according to the HA\'s current number of nurses, "99.8% are Hong Kong locally trained nurses," clearly implementing the local-talent-first hiring policy. He also pointed out that currently 40% of nurses work in the public healthcare system, while the remaining 60% serve in other healthcare roles, such as community nursing, elderly care, rehabilitation services, and private medical institutions. He stressed that society\'s demand for nurses has long existed, and the government will, based on healthcare service needs, exchange views with the industry and academia to plan well for medical and nursing training and manpower development.'}
